newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita says may reach '97 property profit.
newsitem.headline: Merita says may reach '97 property profit.

text.p: Finnish Merita Bank's loss-making real estate unit Merita Kiinteistot Oy (Merita Real Estate Ltd) may turn into the black next year, Merita Kiinteistot managing director Heikki Hypponen said.
"Since interest rates have fallen, there is scope for a positive result next year," Hypponen told Reuters on Monday.
He was asked about the unit's earnings prospects after Merita's agreement with international hotel chain ITT Sheraton to run Merita's Hotel Kamp in Helsinki.
Merita Kiinteistot's 22.6 billion markka in real estate holdings makes it the biggest private property owner in Finland.
Merita Kiinteistot made a 53 million markka operating loss in January-September. It was set up in June 1995 and has no comparable figures for that year.
